description:
OnchainPulse: Intelligence API for the onchain financial transition. Decodes legislation, tracks RWA tokenization, models sector scenarios, guides onchain integration. All endpoints require x402 payment (USDC on Ba

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • legislation ($0.15): Translate crypto bills to plain English with sector impact
  • rwa ($0.15): Survey the real-world-asset market across asset classes
  • scenario ($0.20): Model sector impact scenarios with if/then analysis
  • transition ($0.10): Guide practical onchain onboarding by organization type
  • monitor ($0.10): Monitor institutional onchain activity, weekly briefs
  • compliance ($0.15): Map regulatory compliance duties by jurisdiction
  • tokenize ($0.15): Explain how to tokenize any asset type, step by step
  • glossary ($0.05): Decode any onchain finance or regulatory term plainly
  • snapshot ($0.10): Summarize the onchain transition in a weekly macro brief
  • memecoin ($0.015): Scan a Solana memecoin pre-trade, deterministic verdict
  • evmtoken ($0.015): Scan an EVM token pre-trade, multi-chain, deterministic
  • rwa-risk ($0.25): Assess issuer and redemption risk for a named RWA product
  • gold-check ($0.15): Compare tokenized gold products: PAXG vs XAUT
  • etf-flows ($0.15): Track US spot crypto ETF flows with per-issuer detail
  • clarity-watch ($0.10): Track CLARITY Act status, CFTC/SEC split, passage odds
  • vault-apy ($0.02): Live USDC yield panel on Base — onchain lending rates + realized Morpho vault APY, deterministic
  • asatoken ($0.015): Scan an Algorand ASA pre-trade, deterministic verdict
  • exit-depth ($0.02): Estimate sell-side depth of a v3 pool at 1-25% price impact
  • holder-map ($0.02): Map holder concentration with LP/burn/contract labeling
  • narrative-check ($0.15): Check a project's public claims against observed chain data
  • receipts ($0.35): One-call composite token due-diligence report
  • honeypot ($0.005): Check honeypot sellability flags, half a cent
  • liquidity ($0.005): Check token DEX liquidity and momentum, half a cent
  • rh-launches ($0.01): Live Uniswap-launchpad launch feed on Robinhood Chain, one cent
  • iso-receipt ($0.05): ISO 20022 camt.054-style receipt for an on-chain settlement (signed, verifiable)
  • rwa-bnb ($0.15): Rank every RWA protocol by its BNB Chain TVL slice
  • yield-check ($0.05): Reality-check a dividend/reflection token's promised yield against live volume
  • token-safety ($0.015): Token safety check for any token on 10 chains — is this token safe to buy? Deterministic CLEAR/CAUTION/AVOID verdict, chain auto-detected

asset_class.description: Specific asset class focus (e.g. 'US Treasuries', 'real estate', 'private credit')

asset_type.description: Asset type to analyze (e.g. 'real estate', 'equity', 'bond', 'private credit', 'art')

chain.description: EVM chain (default base; robinhood = Robinhood Chain)

context.description: Additional context about the user's situation

framework.description: Specific framework to focus on (e.g. 'MiCA', 'GENIUS Act')

holding_pct.description: Holding as percent of supply for per-holder math

limit.description: max launches to return, 1-50 (default 25); newest first

min_tvl_usd.description: Exclude protocols below this BNB-chain TVL in USD (default 10000)

payout_share_pct.description: Percent of tax paid to holders (default 100)

perspective.description: Account-holder address: its inflows become credits, outflows debits

pool.description: v3-compatible pool address to read directly (overrides token resolution)

promised_daily_usd.description: Promised whole-pool daily payout in USD to compare

q.description: Bill name or topic (e.g. 'GENIUS Act', 'stablecoin regulation', 'MiCA')

sector.description: Sector to focus on, or 'all' for comprehensive coverage

term.description: Term to explain (e.g. 'atomic settlement', 'MiCA', 'CASP', 'yield bearing stablecoin', 'RWA')

token.description: ERC-20 token address — primary pool auto-resolved via DexScreener

trigger.description: The development to model (e.g. 'GENIUS Act passes', 'DTCC full tokenization launch', 'MiCA enforcement begins')

url.description: Project's public website URL or domain

use_case.description: What the entity wants to do (e.g. 'issue a stablecoin', 'operate a crypto exchange', 'accept USDC payments')

vault.description: Optional address of ANY ERC-4626 vault on Base to read alongside the standard panel.

window.description: Trailing window in days for realized ERC-4626 vault APY (share-price delta, annualized).

name: onchainpulse
